correct_completion: had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
full_sentence: Never before had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
acceptable_variants: had the firm encountered such a severe financial crisis.
had the company ever faced such a serious financial crisis.

options.text: the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
options.why_wrong: This is a plain statement with normal word order. It ignores the inversion that a negative adverbial at the start of the sentence requires.

options.text: had the company faced such a serious financial crisis.
the company faced such a serious financial crisis never before.
options.why_wrong: Negative adverbials cannot simply move to the end here. The auxiliary must come before the subject when the adverbial starts the sentence.

options.text: the company has faced such a serious financial crisis.
options.why_wrong: This is a normal present perfect statement. It does not use the emphatic inverted structure that 'never before' triggers.

explanation: When a negative adverbial such as 'never before' opens a sentence, English places the auxiliary verb before the subject for emphasis. Portuguese speakers often keep the normal subject-verb order here, because Portuguese does not invert the subject in this way after negative expressions.
translation: Nunca antes a empresa havia enfrentado uma crise financeira tão grave.
